mid_weak.state_note: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes

old_thin.state_note: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

gate2_field_check.note: This allocation experiment does not depend on these fields.

hypothesis: Default cap-bound core entries may be underallocated after the accepted narrow cap/risk overlays; modestly relaxing the default single-position cap could increase expected value without changing entries, exits, ranking, candidate pool, LLM authority, or filters.
known_risks: High multiple-testing risk around cap and capacity family.
Best sweep result improved aggregate EV but amplified at least one weak-window loser.
Replay-only monkey patch is not production behavior.
next_evidence_needed: Do not retry broad default cap values on the same fixed sample. If this mechanism is revisited, use a new production-visible cap-bound quality state that avoids old_thin V-style loser amplification and promote only through shared constants/policy with a parity test.

production_impact.notes: No strategy behavior changed. The cap values were tested by a local monkey patch only; no positive result is kept without shared policy promotion.

rejection_reason: Best variant failed Gate 4 because at least one fixed window regressed in EV; do not promote a broad default cap retune from mixed-window evidence.
single_causal_variable: experiment-only monkey patch of portfolio_engine.MAX_POSITION_PCT; all entries, exits, ranking, filters, universe, LLM/news replay, and accepted narrow overlay caps stay fixed
why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking due sparse attribution, broad-market identity because recent controls failed, event fact-tone/governance near-neighbor scalars due repeated mixed evidence, and state-surface notional/capital retunes due the stricter same-family materiality gate.
